Name: Shopping Show
Author: AvalonMFX
Description:
Explanation

[list=1]
[*]The TV channel offers items from the traveling merchant's item pool (except furniture) at the same prices.
[*]After purchasing an item, the TV channel will be unavailable until it resets.
[*]The item will be delivered by tomorrow.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oHvFsdq.png[/img]

[b]Instant Delivery: [/b]The Item will be added immediately to your mailbox after the purchase
[b]Hours until next show: [/b]The amount of hours that have to pass until the channel is available again after buying an item

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7H9s3wi.png[/img]

[color=#6aa84f]If you discover any bugs, feel free to report it. I will try to fix every reported bug﻿.[/color]
